candidate_S1.advantage: more known attack classes and a simple single OOD contrast
candidate_S1.leakage: safe only if family is absent from train/val/calibration and no target/test signals rank it
candidate_S1.risk: single surrogate's behavior may not transfer to held-out target
candidate_S1.rule: top one remaining non-target attack family by same train-only ranking

candidate_S2.advantage: multiple distinct OOD families for scorer selection
candidate_S2.leakage: surrogate identities forbidden from backbone, scaler, vocab, checkpoint, centroid, calibration
candidate_S2.risk: removes two classes from representation fit; still may not represent target
candidate_S2.rule: top two remaining non-target attack families by same train-only ranking

ranking_data: official_train post-ambiguity canonical identity counts only
ranking_rule: descending remaining-family identity count, exact label ascending tie-break; exclude target; top two
